summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, letter/number activation, find_tab_by_name, action_range_clicked, and a watcher-driven bar animation); UnderlineBar now takes clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text with click spans added last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style to keep click metadata; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and a new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Syntax was checked by parsing only. Deviations and gaps: bar position uses displayed-tab indices (differs from the full-list find index only when duplicate names precede the active tab); Tabs sets can_focus=True; letter search applies only to single-character keys; a zero-width label edge is treated as flexible by the existing resolver, which I did not change; the sandbox demo and an Opacity metadata test were skipped. The new tests have not been run.
